fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Open Lawn Area; Walkway; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Limited Rear Access
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders identify the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the entrance to the single driveway with reflective posts on both sides so responders can locate it under low-light or smoky conditions.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow fire apparatus and emergency vehicles to reach the residence without delay.
• Install a sign or marker identifying the detached structure so responders arriving on scene can account for all buildings without searching the property.
• Keep a gate or opening at the rear of the property unlocked or clearly marked to give responders an alternate route if the front is blocked.
• Mark the walkway path to the rear of the property so responders can quickly identify a foot-access route when vehicle access is not possible.
• Keep the open lawn area clear of stored equipment, vehicles, or debris so responders can use it as a staging area.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Open Green Space; Tree Cluster; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Grass Cover; None Visible
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin trees within the scattered groupings closest to the structure to increase open space between individual trees.
• Remove any dry or dead grass accumulation directly adjacent to the structure's foundation and walls.
• Keep grass cover trimmed short in open areas immediately surrounding the structure.
• Separate the tree cluster from the structure by removing the nearest trees or lower limbs on the side facing the building.
• Maintain the existing open green space by preventing shrub or tree encroachment into cleared areas over time.
